Class CorrectWord

java.lang.Object
CorrectWord
public class CorrectWord extends Object
A word that can be inspected and transformed.

Exercise on the String methods charAt, length and substring, and on for loops. The class can return the first, last and middle characters of the word, append text to it, reverse it and encrypt it with the Caesar cipher.

    • getCenter

      public String getCenter()
      Returns the central part of the word.

      If the word has an odd number of characters, the single middle character is returned (for example "c" for "abcde"). If it has an even number of characters, the two middle characters are returned (for example "bc" for "abcd").

      Returns:
      the middle character, or the two middle characters

    • caesarCipher

      public String caesarCipher(int k)
      Encrypts the word with the Caesar cipher: every character is shifted forward by k positions in the character table (for example, with k = 3, "abc" becomes "def"). The stored word is not modified.
      Parameters:
      k - the key, that is the number of positions to shift
      Returns:
      the encrypted word
